name: ak:ui-ux-pro-max
overview: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile: style selection, color systems, typography, layout, accessibility, interaction states, responsive behavior, forms, charts, design systems, and code review across React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, and HTML/CSS.
whenToUse: Invoke for UX strategy, design systems, accessibility, or review.

subcommands.name: color-contrast
subcommands.desc: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text (large text 3:1); Material Design

subcommands.name: focus-states
subcommands.desc: Visible focus rings on interactive elements (2–4px; Apple HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: alt-text
subcommands.desc: Descriptive alt text for meaningful images

subcommands.name: aria-labels
subcommands.desc: aria-label for icon-only buttons; accessibilityLabel in native (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: keyboard-nav
subcommands.desc: Tab order matches visual order; full keyboard support (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: form-labels
subcommands.desc: Use label with for attribute

subcommands.name: skip-links
subcommands.desc: Skip to main content for keyboard users

subcommands.name: heading-hierarchy
subcommands.desc: Sequential h1→h6, no level skip

subcommands.name: color-not-only
subcommands.desc: Don't convey info by color alone (add icon/text)

subcommands.name: dynamic-type
subcommands.desc: Support system text scaling; avoid truncation as text grows (Apple Dynamic Type, MD)

subcommands.name: reduced-motion
subcommands.desc: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; reduce/disable animations when requested (Apple Reduced Motion API, MD)

subcommands.name: voiceover-sr
subcommands.desc: Meaningful accessibilityLabel/accessibilityHint; logical reading order for VoiceOver/screen readers (Apple HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: escape-routes
subcommands.desc: Provide cancel/back in modals and multi-step flows (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: keyboard-shortcuts
subcommands.desc: Preserve system and a11y shortcuts; offer keyboard alternatives for drag-and-drop (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: touch-target-size
subcommands.desc: Min 44×44pt (Apple) / 48×48dp (Material); extend hit area beyond visual bounds if needed

subcommands.name: touch-spacing
subcommands.desc: Minimum 8px/8dp gap between touch targets (Apple HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: hover-vs-tap
subcommands.desc: Use click/tap for primary interactions; don't rely on hover alone

subcommands.name: loading-buttons
subcommands.desc: Disable button during async operations; show spinner or progress

subcommands.name: error-feedback
subcommands.desc: Clear error messages near problem

subcommands.name: cursor-pointer
subcommands.desc: Add cursor-pointer to clickable elements (Web)

subcommands.name: gesture-conflicts
subcommands.desc: Avoid horizontal swipe on main content; prefer vertical scroll

subcommands.name: tap-delay
subcommands.desc: Use touch-action: manipulation to reduce 300ms delay (Web)

subcommands.name: standard-gestures
subcommands.desc: Use platform standard gestures consistently; don't redefine (e.g. swipe-back, pinch-zoom) (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: system-gestures
subcommands.desc: Don't block system gestures (Control Center, back swipe, etc.) (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: press-feedback
subcommands.desc: Visual feedback on press (ripple/highlight; MD state layers)

subcommands.name: haptic-feedback
subcommands.desc: Use haptic for confirmations and important actions; avoid overuse (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: gesture-alternative
subcommands.desc: Don't rely on gesture-only interactions; always provide visible controls for critical actions

subcommands.name: safe-area-awareness
subcommands.desc: Keep primary touch targets away from notch, Dynamic Island, gesture bar and screen edges

subcommands.name: no-precision-required
subcommands.desc: Avoid requiring pixel-perfect taps on small icons or thin edges

subcommands.name: swipe-clarity
subcommands.desc: Swipe actions must show clear affordance or hint (chevron, label, tutorial)

subcommands.name: drag-threshold
subcommands.desc: Use a movement threshold before starting drag to avoid accidental drags

subcommands.name: image-optimization
subcommands.desc: Use WebP/AVIF, responsive images (srcset/sizes), lazy load non-critical assets

subcommands.name: image-dimension
subcommands.desc: Declare width/height or use aspect-ratio to prevent layout shift (Core Web Vitals: CLS)

subcommands.name: font-loading
subcommands.desc: Use font-display: swap/optional to avoid invisible text (FOIT); reserve space to reduce layout shift (MD)

subcommands.name: font-preload
subcommands.desc: Preload only critical fonts; avoid overusing preload on every variant

subcommands.name: critical-css
subcommands.desc: Prioritize above-the-fold CSS (inline critical CSS or early-loaded stylesheet)

subcommands.name: lazy-loading
subcommands.desc: Lazy load non-hero components via dynamic import / route-level splitting

subcommands.name: bundle-splitting
subcommands.desc: Split code by route/feature (React Suspense / Next.js dynamic) to reduce initial load and TTI

subcommands.name: third-party-scripts
subcommands.desc: Load third-party scripts async/defer; audit and remove unnecessary ones (MD)

subcommands.name: reduce-reflows
subcommands.desc: Avoid frequent layout reads/writes; batch DOM reads then writes

subcommands.name: content-jumping
subcommands.desc: Reserve space for async content to avoid layout jumps (Core Web Vitals: CLS)

subcommands.name: lazy-load-below-fold
subcommands.desc: Use loading="lazy" for below-the-fold images and heavy media

subcommands.name: virtualize-lists
subcommands.desc: Virtualize lists with 50+ items to improve memory efficiency and scroll performance

subcommands.name: main-thread-budget
subcommands.desc: Keep per-frame work under ~16ms for 60fps; move heavy tasks off main thread (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: progressive-loading
subcommands.desc: Use skeleton screens / shimmer instead of long blocking spinners for >1s operations (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: input-latency
subcommands.desc: Keep input latency under ~100ms for taps/scrolls (Material responsiveness standard)

subcommands.name: tap-feedback-speed
subcommands.desc: Provide visual feedback within 100ms of tap (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: debounce-throttle
subcommands.desc: Use debounce/throttle for high-frequency events (scroll, resize, input)

subcommands.name: offline-support
subcommands.desc: Provide offline state messaging and basic fallback (PWA / mobile)

subcommands.name: network-fallback
subcommands.desc: Offer degraded modes for slow networks (lower-res images, fewer animations)

subcommands.name: style-match
subcommands.desc: Match style to product type (use `--design-system` for recommendations)

subcommands.name: consistency
subcommands.desc: Use same style across all pages

subcommands.name: no-emoji-icons
subcommands.desc: Use SVG icons (Heroicons, Lucide), not emojis

subcommands.name: color-palette-from-product
subcommands.desc: Choose palette from product/industry (search `--domain color`)

subcommands.name: effects-match-style
subcommands.desc: Shadows, blur, radius aligned with chosen style (glass / flat / clay etc.)

subcommands.name: platform-adaptive
subcommands.desc: Respect platform idioms (iOS HIG vs Material): navigation, controls, typography, motion

subcommands.name: state-clarity
subcommands.desc: Make hover/pressed/disabled states visually distinct while staying on-style (Material state layers)

subcommands.name: elevation-consistent
subcommands.desc: Use a consistent elevation/shadow scale for cards, sheets, modals; avoid random shadow values

subcommands.name: dark-mode-pairing
subcommands.desc: Design light/dark variants together to keep brand, contrast, and style consistent

subcommands.name: icon-style-consistent
subcommands.desc: Use one icon set/visual language (stroke width, corner radius) across the product

subcommands.name: system-controls
subcommands.desc: Prefer native/system controls over fully custom ones; only customize when branding requires it (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: blur-purpose
subcommands.desc: Use blur to indicate background dismissal (modals, sheets), not as decoration (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: primary-action
subcommands.desc: Each screen should have only one primary CTA; secondary actions visually subordinate (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: viewport-meta
subcommands.desc: width=device-width initial-scale=1 (never disable zoom)

subcommands.name: mobile-first
subcommands.desc: Design mobile-first, then scale up to tablet and desktop

subcommands.name: breakpoint-consistency
subcommands.desc: Use systematic breakpoints (e.g. 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440)

subcommands.name: readable-font-size
subcommands.desc: Minimum 16px body text on mobile (avoids iOS auto-zoom)

subcommands.name: line-length-control
subcommands.desc: Mobile 35–60 chars per line; desktop 60–75 chars

subcommands.name: horizontal-scroll
subcommands.desc: No horizontal scroll on mobile; ensure content fits viewport width

subcommands.name: spacing-scale
subcommands.desc: Use 4pt/8dp incremental spacing system (Material Design)

subcommands.name: touch-density
subcommands.desc: Keep component spacing comfortable for touch: not cramped, not causing mis-taps

subcommands.name: container-width
subcommands.desc: Consistent max-width on desktop (max-w-6xl / 7xl)

subcommands.name: z-index-management
subcommands.desc: Define layered z-index scale (e.g. 0 / 10 / 20 / 40 / 100 / 1000)

subcommands.name: fixed-element-offset
subcommands.desc: Fixed navbar/bottom bar must reserve safe padding for underlying content

subcommands.name: scroll-behavior
subcommands.desc: Avoid nested scroll regions that interfere with the main scroll experience

subcommands.name: viewport-units
subcommands.desc: Prefer min-h-dvh over 100vh on mobile

subcommands.name: orientation-support
subcommands.desc: Keep layout readable and operable in landscape mode

subcommands.name: content-priority
subcommands.desc: Show core content first on mobile; fold or hide secondary content

subcommands.name: visual-hierarchy
subcommands.desc: Establish hierarchy via size, spacing, contrast — not color alone

subcommands.name: line-height
subcommands.desc: Use 1.5-1.75 for body text

subcommands.name: line-length
subcommands.desc: Limit to 65-75 characters per line

subcommands.name: font-pairing
subcommands.desc: Match heading/body font personalities

subcommands.name: font-scale
subcommands.desc: Consistent type scale (e.g. 12 14 16 18 24 32)

subcommands.name: contrast-readability
subcommands.desc: Darker text on light backgrounds (e.g. slate-900 on white)

subcommands.name: text-styles-system
subcommands.desc: Use platform type system: iOS 11 Dynamic Type styles / Material 5 type roles (display, headline, title, body, label) (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: weight-hierarchy
subcommands.desc: Use font-weight to reinforce hierarchy: Bold headings (600–700), Regular body (400), Medium labels (500) (MD)

subcommands.name: color-semantic
subcommands.desc: Define semantic color tokens (primary, secondary, error, surface, on-surface) not raw hex in components (Material color system)

subcommands.name: color-dark-mode
subcommands.desc: Dark mode uses desaturated / lighter tonal variants, not inverted colors; test contrast separately (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: color-accessible-pairs
subcommands.desc: Foreground/background pairs must meet 4.5:1 (AA) or 7:1 (AAA); use tools to verify (WCAG, MD)

subcommands.name: color-not-decorative-only
subcommands.desc: Functional color (error red, success green) must include icon/text; avoid color-only meaning (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: truncation-strategy
subcommands.desc: Prefer wrapping over truncation; when truncating use ellipsis and provide full text via tooltip/expand (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: letter-spacing
subcommands.desc: Respect default letter-spacing per platform; avoid tight tracking on body text (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: number-tabular
subcommands.desc: Use tabular/monospaced figures for data columns, prices, and timers to prevent layout shift

subcommands.name: whitespace-balance
subcommands.desc: Use whitespace intentionally to group related items and separate sections; avoid visual clutter (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: duration-timing
subcommands.desc: Use 150–300ms for micro-interactions; complex transitions ≤400ms; avoid >500ms (MD)

subcommands.name: transform-performance
subcommands.desc: Use transform/opacity only; avoid animating width/height/top/left

subcommands.name: loading-states
subcommands.desc: Show skeleton or progress indicator when loading exceeds 300ms

subcommands.name: excessive-motion
subcommands.desc: Animate 1-2 key elements per view max

subcommands.name: easing
subcommands.desc: Use ease-out for entering, ease-in for exiting; avoid linear for UI transitions

subcommands.name: motion-meaning
subcommands.desc: Every animation must express a cause-effect relationship, not just be decorative (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: state-transition
subcommands.desc: State changes (hover / active / expanded / collapsed / modal) should animate smoothly, not snap

subcommands.name: continuity
subcommands.desc: Page/screen transitions should maintain spatial continuity (shared element, directional slide) (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: parallax-subtle
subcommands.desc: Use parallax sparingly; must respect reduced-motion and not cause disorientation (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: spring-physics
subcommands.desc: Prefer spring/physics-based curves over linear or cubic-bezier for natural feel (Apple HIG fluid animations)

subcommands.name: exit-faster-than-enter
subcommands.desc: Exit animations shorter than enter (~60–70% of enter duration) to feel responsive (MD motion)

subcommands.name: stagger-sequence
subcommands.desc: Stagger list/grid item entrance by 30–50ms per item; avoid all-at-once or too-slow reveals (MD)

subcommands.name: shared-element-transition
subcommands.desc: Use shared element / hero transitions for visual continuity between screens (MD, HIG)

subcommands.name: interruptible
subcommands.desc: Animations must be interruptible; user tap/gesture cancels in-progress animation immediately (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: no-blocking-animation
subcommands.desc: Never block user input during an animation; UI must stay interactive (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: fade-crossfade
subcommands.desc: Use crossfade for content replacement within the same container (MD)

subcommands.name: scale-feedback
subcommands.desc: Subtle scale (0.95–1.05) on press for tappable cards/buttons; restore on release (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: gesture-feedback
subcommands.desc: Drag, swipe, and pinch must provide real-time visual response tracking the finger (MD Motion)

subcommands.name: hierarchy-motion
subcommands.desc: Use translate/scale direction to express hierarchy: enter from below = deeper, exit upward = back (MD)

subcommands.name: motion-consistency
subcommands.desc: Unify duration/easing tokens globally; all animations share the same rhythm and feel

subcommands.name: opacity-threshold
subcommands.desc: Fading elements should not linger below opacity 0.2; either fade fully or remain visible

subcommands.name: modal-motion
subcommands.desc: Modals/sheets should animate from their trigger source (scale+fade or slide-in) for spatial context (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: navigation-direction
subcommands.desc: Forward navigation animates left/up; backward animates right/down — keep direction logically consistent (HIG)

subcommands.name: layout-shift-avoid
subcommands.desc: Animations must not cause layout reflow or CLS; use transform for position changes

subcommands.name: input-labels
subcommands.desc: Visible label per input (not placeholder-only)

subcommands.name: error-placement
subcommands.desc: Show error below the related field

subcommands.name: submit-feedback
subcommands.desc: Loading then success/error state on submit

subcommands.name: required-indicators
subcommands.desc: Mark required fields (e.g. asterisk)

subcommands.name: empty-states
subcommands.desc: Helpful message and action when no content

subcommands.name: toast-dismiss
subcommands.desc: Auto-dismiss toasts in 3-5s

subcommands.name: confirmation-dialogs
subcommands.desc: Confirm before destructive actions

subcommands.name: input-helper-text
subcommands.desc: Provide persistent helper text below complex inputs, not just placeholder (Material Design)

subcommands.name: disabled-states
subcommands.desc: Disabled elements use reduced opacity (0.38–0.5) + cursor change + semantic attribute (MD)

subcommands.name: progressive-disclosure
subcommands.desc: Reveal complex options progressively; don't overwhelm users upfront (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: inline-validation
subcommands.desc: Validate on blur (not keystroke); show error only after user finishes input (MD)

subcommands.name: input-type-keyboard
subcommands.desc: Use semantic input types (email, tel, number) to trigger the correct mobile keyboard (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: password-toggle
subcommands.desc: Provide show/hide toggle for password fields (MD)

subcommands.name: autofill-support
subcommands.desc: Use autocomplete / textContentType attributes so the system can autofill (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: undo-support
subcommands.desc: Allow undo for destructive or bulk actions (e.g. "Undo delete" toast) (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: success-feedback
subcommands.desc: Confirm completed actions with brief visual feedback (checkmark, toast, color flash) (MD)

subcommands.name: error-recovery
subcommands.desc: Error messages must include a clear recovery path (retry, edit, help link) (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: multi-step-progress
subcommands.desc: Multi-step flows show step indicator or progress bar; allow back navigation (MD)

subcommands.name: form-autosave
subcommands.desc: Long forms should auto-save drafts to prevent data loss on accidental dismissal (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: sheet-dismiss-confirm
subcommands.desc: Confirm before dismissing a sheet/modal with unsaved changes (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: error-clarity
subcommands.desc: Error messages must state cause + how to fix (not just "Invalid input") (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: field-grouping
subcommands.desc: Group related fields logically (fieldset/legend or visual grouping) (MD)

subcommands.name: read-only-distinction
subcommands.desc: Read-only state should be visually and semantically different from disabled (MD)

subcommands.name: focus-management
subcommands.desc: After submit error, auto-focus the first invalid field (WCAG, MD)

subcommands.name: error-summary
subcommands.desc: For multiple errors, show summary at top with anchor links to each field (WCAG)

subcommands.name: touch-friendly-input
subcommands.desc: Mobile input height ≥44px to meet touch target requirements (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: destructive-emphasis
subcommands.desc: Destructive actions use semantic danger color (red) and are visually separated from primary actions (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: toast-accessibility
subcommands.desc: Toasts must not steal focus; use aria-live="polite" for screen reader announcement (WCAG)

subcommands.name: aria-live-errors
subcommands.desc: Form errors use aria-live region or role="alert" to notify screen readers (WCAG)

subcommands.name: contrast-feedback
subcommands.desc: Error and success state colors must meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio (WCAG, MD)

subcommands.name: timeout-feedback
subcommands.desc: Request timeout must show clear feedback with retry option (MD)

subcommands.name: bottom-nav-limit
subcommands.desc: Bottom navigation max 5 items; use labels with icons (Material Design)

subcommands.name: drawer-usage
subcommands.desc: Use drawer/sidebar for secondary navigation, not primary actions (Material Design)

subcommands.name: back-behavior
subcommands.desc: Back navigation must be predictable and consistent; preserve scroll/state (Apple HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: deep-linking
subcommands.desc: All key screens must be reachable via deep link / URL for sharing and notifications (Apple HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: tab-bar-ios
subcommands.desc: iOS: use bottom Tab Bar for top-level navigation (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: top-app-bar-android
subcommands.desc: Android: use Top App Bar with navigation icon for primary structure (Material Design)

subcommands.name: nav-label-icon
subcommands.desc: Navigation items must have both icon and text label; icon-only nav harms discoverability (MD)

subcommands.name: nav-state-active
subcommands.desc: Current location must be visually highlighted (color, weight, indicator) in navigation (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: nav-hierarchy
subcommands.desc: Primary nav (tabs/bottom bar) vs secondary nav (drawer/settings) must be clearly separated (MD)

subcommands.name: modal-escape
subcommands.desc: Modals and sheets must offer a clear close/dismiss affordance; swipe-down to dismiss on mobile (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: search-accessible
subcommands.desc: Search must be easily reachable (top bar or tab); provide recent/suggested queries (MD)

subcommands.name: breadcrumb-web
subcommands.desc: Web: use breadcrumbs for 3+ level deep hierarchies to aid orientation (MD)

subcommands.name: state-preservation
subcommands.desc: Navigating back must restore previous scroll position, filter state, and input (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: gesture-nav-support
subcommands.desc: Support system gesture navigation (iOS swipe-back, Android predictive back) without conflict (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: tab-badge
subcommands.desc: Use badges on nav items sparingly to indicate unread/pending; clear after user visits (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: overflow-menu
subcommands.desc: When actions exceed available space, use overflow/more menu instead of cramming (MD)

subcommands.name: bottom-nav-top-level
subcommands.desc: Bottom nav is for top-level screens only; never nest sub-navigation inside it (MD)

subcommands.name: adaptive-navigation
subcommands.desc: Large screens (≥1024px) prefer sidebar; small screens use bottom/top nav (Material Adaptive)

subcommands.name: back-stack-integrity
subcommands.desc: Never silently reset the navigation stack or unexpectedly jump to home (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: navigation-consistency
subcommands.desc: Navigation placement must stay the same across all pages; don't change by page type

subcommands.name: avoid-mixed-patterns
subcommands.desc: Don't mix Tab + Sidebar + Bottom Nav at the same hierarchy level

subcommands.name: modal-vs-navigation
subcommands.desc: Modals must not be used for primary navigation flows; they break the user's path (HIG)

subcommands.name: focus-on-route-change
subcommands.desc: After page transition, move focus to main content region for screen reader users (WCAG)

subcommands.name: persistent-nav
subcommands.desc: Core navigation must remain reachable from deep pages; don't hide it entirely in sub-flows (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: destructive-nav-separation
subcommands.desc: Dangerous actions (delete account, logout) must be visually and spatially separated from normal nav items (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: empty-nav-state
subcommands.desc: When a nav destination is unavailable, explain why instead of silently hiding it (MD)

subcommands.name: chart-type
subcommands.desc: Match chart type to data type (trend → line, comparison → bar, proportion → pie/donut)

subcommands.name: color-guidance
subcommands.desc: Use accessible color palettes; avoid red/green only pairs for colorblind users (WCAG, MD)

subcommands.name: data-table
subcommands.desc: Provide table alternative for accessibility; charts alone are not screen-reader friendly (WCAG)

subcommands.name: pattern-texture
subcommands.desc: Supplement color with patterns, textures, or shapes so data is distinguishable without color (WCAG, MD)

subcommands.name: legend-visible
subcommands.desc: Always show legend; position near the chart, not detached below a scroll fold (MD)

subcommands.name: tooltip-on-interact
subcommands.desc: Provide tooltips/data labels on hover (Web) or tap (mobile) showing exact values (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: axis-labels
subcommands.desc: Label axes with units and readable scale; avoid truncated or rotated labels on mobile

subcommands.name: responsive-chart
subcommands.desc: Charts must reflow or simplify on small screens (e.g. horizontal bar instead of vertical, fewer ticks)

subcommands.name: empty-data-state
subcommands.desc: Show meaningful empty state when no data exists ("No data yet" + guidance), not a blank chart (MD)

subcommands.name: loading-chart
subcommands.desc: Use skeleton or shimmer placeholder while chart data loads; don't show an empty axis frame

subcommands.name: animation-optional
subcommands.desc: Chart entrance animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion; data should be readable immediately (HIG)

subcommands.name: large-dataset
subcommands.desc: For 1000+ data points, aggregate or sample; provide drill-down for detail instead of rendering all (MD)

subcommands.name: number-formatting
subcommands.desc: Use locale-aware formatting for numbers, dates, currencies on axes and labels (HIG, MD)

subcommands.name: touch-target-chart
subcommands.desc: Interactive chart elements (points, segments) must have ≥44pt tap area or expand on touch (Apple HIG)

subcommands.name: no-pie-overuse
subcommands.desc: Avoid pie/donut for >5 categories; switch to bar chart for clarity

subcommands.name: contrast-data
subcommands.desc: Data lines/bars vs background ≥3:1; data text labels ≥4.5:1 (WCAG)

subcommands.name: legend-interactive
subcommands.desc: Legends should be clickable to toggle series visibility (MD)

subcommands.name: direct-labeling
subcommands.desc: For small datasets, label values directly on the chart to reduce eye travel

subcommands.name: tooltip-keyboard
subcommands.desc: Tooltip content must be keyboard-reachable and not rely on hover alone (WCAG)

subcommands.name: sortable-table
subcommands.desc: Data tables must support sorting with aria-sort indicating current sort state (WCAG)

subcommands.name: axis-readability
subcommands.desc: Axis ticks must not be cramped; maintain readable spacing, auto-skip on small screens

subcommands.name: data-density
subcommands.desc: Limit information density per chart to avoid cognitive overload; split into multiple charts if needed

subcommands.name: trend-emphasis
subcommands.desc: Emphasize data trends over decoration; avoid heavy gradients/shadows that obscure the data

subcommands.name: gridline-subtle
subcommands.desc: Grid lines should be low-contrast (e.g. gray-200) so they don't compete with data

subcommands.name: focusable-elements
subcommands.desc: Interactive chart elements (points, bars, slices) must be keyboard-navigable (WCAG)

subcommands.name: screen-reader-summary
subcommands.desc: Provide a text summary or aria-label describing the chart's key insight for screen readers (WCAG)

subcommands.name: error-state-chart
subcommands.desc: Data load failure must show error message with retry action, not a broken/empty chart

subcommands.name: export-option
subcommands.desc: For data-heavy products, offer CSV/image export of chart data

subcommands.name: drill-down-consistency
subcommands.desc: Drill-down interactions must maintain a clear back-path and hierarchy breadcrumb

subcommands.name: time-scale-clarity
subcommands.desc: Time series charts must clearly label time granularity (day/week/month) and allow switching

subcommands.name: product
subcommands.desc: Product type recommendations

subcommands.name: style
subcommands.desc: UI styles, colors, effects

subcommands.name: typography
subcommands.desc: Font pairings, Google Fonts

subcommands.name: color
subcommands.desc: Color palettes by product type

subcommands.name: landing
subcommands.desc: Page structure, CTA strategies

subcommands.name: chart
subcommands.desc: Chart types, library recommendations

subcommands.name: ux
subcommands.desc: Best practices, anti-patterns

subcommands.name: google-fonts
subcommands.desc: Individual Google Fonts lookup

subcommands.name: react
subcommands.desc: React/Next.js performance

subcommands.name: web
subcommands.desc: App interface guidelines (iOS/Android/React Native)

subcommands.name: prompt
subcommands.desc: AI prompts, CSS keywords

subcommands.name: react-native
subcommands.desc: Components, Navigation, Lists
